why_now.business_demand: B2B SaaS companies, design studios, and agencies require marketing sites that marketing teams can independently update via CMS without developer bottlenecks.
why_now.career_opportunity: Webflow visual developers build high-value marketing sites, command strong agency roles, and deliver high-margin freelance website projects.

webflow_plan_transparency.summary: Clear distinction between Workspace Plans, Site Hosting Plans, and Static Code Export limitations.
webflow_plan_transparency.workspace_plans: Workspace plans govern team seats, workspace-level collaboration, and eligible code export permissions.
webflow_plan_transparency.site_plans: Site plans govern custom domain publishing, CMS database capacity, hosted form submissions, and production site bandwidth.
webflow_plan_transparency.static_code_export_limitation: Exporting static HTML, CSS, and JS requires an eligible paid Workspace plan. Crucially, static code export does NOT include native Webflow CMS dynamic functionality or native hosted form processing, requiring external backend hosting and alternative form endpoints if hosted outside Webflow.

modules.module_purpose: Develop an understanding of web layout architecture and the Webflow Designer environment.

Main axis distribution: flex-start, center, flex-end, space-between, space-around
Cross axis alignment: stretch, flex-start, center, flex-end, baseline
Flex wrap settings for fluid multi-element cards

Complex layout composition using nested flex containers

subtopics: The Webflow breakpoint cascade: changes flow down to mobile
Adapting layouts for Tablet (768px-991px)

lessons.what_is_taught: Professional CSS class naming systems (Client-First / BEM methodology principles), reusable global classes, combo classes, class inheritance, and avoiding redundant class bloat.

lessons.what_is_taught: Webflow Variables: creating color variables, typography values, spacing tokens, size variables, global updates, and design token integration.

lessons.what_is_taught: Building Webflow components: navigation bars, footer systems, feature cards, testimonial modules, CTA callouts, and component properties (override text, visibility, links).

faq.question: What will I learn in this Webflow course?
faq.answer: You will learn Webflow Designer, visual CSS, responsive layouts, reusable components, CMS collections, dynamic templates, interactions, SEO and publishing workflows.

faq.question: Do I need coding knowledge?
faq.answer: Basic HTML/CSS concepts are recommended, but professional programming experience is not required.

faq.question: Will I build a CMS website?
faq.answer: Yes. The capstone focuses on a multi-page marketing website with structured CMS content, dynamic templates and a client editor workflow, using an appropriately authorized environment.

faq.question: Is Webflow free to use?
faq.answer: Webflow provides limited introductory options. Publishing to custom domains and accessing certain CMS, collaboration or other features may require paid plans.

faq.question: Can I export Webflow CMS websites and host them anywhere?
faq.answer: Webflow supports static code export with an eligible paid Workspace plan, but native CMS functionality and other hosted features are not fully included in that export.

faq.question: Will I learn animations?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn useful hover, scroll and transition interactions while considering performance and accessibility.

faq.question: Will I learn SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. The course covers metadata, CMS SEO, redirects, accessibility and basic technical SEO concepts.

faq.question: What portfolio project will I complete?
faq.answer: A responsive multi-page Webflow CMS marketing website with reusable components, CMS content, forms, suitable interactions and handover documentation.

faq.question: Is this different from Elementor?
faq.answer: Yes. Elementor is a visual design tool used with WordPress. Webflow is a visual website development and hosting platform with its own CMS and design system.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: Eight weeks, 64 guided hours and ₹10,900, subject to Nova Skills' verified pricing and tax policy.
